title: KernelMemoryObject
description: Version 1 input contract for Membrane context compilation. semantic_tier matches firewall tiers: 1=procedural, 2=semantic, 3=episodic.

id.description: Stable identifier for the memory row.

payload.description: Primary text (or stringified content) fed to layout and token estimates.

relevance_score.description: Retrieval relevance in [0, +inf); higher is more relevant.

temporal_weight.description: Decay-adjusted weight for ordering (1.0 = full weight).

provenance.description: Opaque source metadata (store id, URI, chunk id, etc.).
